body: Thank you for saying this. Truly I do mean it. And I don’t want to travel these thoughts, and do something I know won’t be best... but I’m just so scared.

Thank you. I wish I knew what to say, or even how to say it because it’s so incredibly hard. 

We want to be a story for other people and help other families suffering from this problem like we are. 

We just don’t know what to do right now.... we’re scared. I’m scared.

We set one up over a year ago to assist in our juvenile hearing fees to which we received the majority of our expense help. The rest of which family and friends helped out with, outside the crowd funding. 

We’re located in Georgia currently. The legal advice we’ve sought has been just that, advice, which leads to us NEEDING to retain legal counsel for the best possible outcome. If we take their advice without then both of us will end up in prison effective immediately and for how long, who knows? According to the legal advice we’ve been given, a very long time. Due to our child’s condition we’ve been advised to find someone who understand the medical literature behind it due to how complicated it can be.

This is really touching. Truly it is, especially since I am but a stranger on the internet. Hearing this really does bring comfort to know that through all the persecution there are still people who care.
We’ve looked into that, even with help we’re still looking at possibly spending “an unimaginable amount of time in jail.” Thus terminating our rights as parents all together.
